description: PdfCraft: An open-source PDF reader and editor written by scratch in pure Rust

latest_release.name: PdfCraft v0.19.0
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* fix(ui): size the whole-page raster allowance to the pages on screen by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/6065
* fix(ui): continuous view renders the pages ahead of the scroll by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/6063
* Scroll: smooth wheel bursts and preserve precise movement by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/6031
* refactor(ui): tell page modules whether a press is theirs (router PR 4a) by @alehel in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/5803
* M11: JBIG2 encodes only what its decoder takes: Optimize no longer stores large images PdfCraft can't draw by @Piohrun in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/5511
* fix(render): JBIG2 refinement reads 0 past its reference's width (hayro-jbig2 patch 13) by @Piohrun in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/5999
* M1: encryption reads every legal form: crypt filters by reference, a stream's own filter on screen, and full saves that keep /Encrypt by @Piohrun in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/5548
* fix(render): a JBIG2 refinement of the page refines only its area (hayro-jbig2 patch 16) by @Piohrun in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/6058
* fix(render): a JBIG2 region located past i32::MAX is off the page (hayro-jbig2 patch 14) by @Piohrun in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/6016
* M11: JBIG2 images share a symbol dictionary, up to 16 at a time (optimize.mono-compression) by @Piohrun in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/5910
* M6: forms decodes field values, renamed calculations and detected pages within shared budgets by @Piohrun in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/6132
* fix(render): a JBIG2 refinement reads a reference right of it from its first column (hayro-jbig2 patch 15) by @Piohrun in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/6048
* feat(organize): export, import and copy bookmark trees (#6018) by @KenM76 in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/6115
* perf(render): undo PNG predictors a byte row at a time (#5430) by @KenM76 in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/5432
* M12: PRC reader crate (`pdfcraft-prc`) (#1297) by @KenM76 in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/5786
* fix(ui): list X.PDF in file pickers on Linux and the BSDs (#5481) by @KenM76 in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/5487
* M12: an XFA check box without a width is as wide as its box and caption by @KenM76 in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/5476
* M12: add a 3D model (U3D or PRC) to a page with a poster (#1297) by @KenM76 in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/5808
* fix(forms): clearing a field's length limit leaves it with none, not its parent field's by @KenM76 in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/5250
* feat(ui): cut, copy and paste bookmark subtrees (#3994) by @KenM76 in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/6125
* fix(edit): an edited OCR phrase under its scan image is drawn on top (#3973) by @KenM76 in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/5396
* M12: headless renderer for PRC models (`pdfcraft-prc-render`), stacked on #5786 by @KenM76 in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/6069
* M12: model_render, a page's 3D model drawn to a PNG (stacked on #6069) by @KenM76 in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/6087
* Pass the Linux signing key to the release workflow by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/6200
* M5.7: the quick bar's Fill & Sign button shows the tool it picks by @agent-reed in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/5435
* fix(ui): About credits tables fit without side-scrolling and their columns resize by @FredApps in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/6052
* M5.7: the Fill & Sign text controls use a colour dot and a size flyout by @agent-reed in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/5754
* M14: Preferences can turn off the update check at start (#5737, #5460) by @hasannadeem in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/5758
*

hot_issues.title: Chinese characters render as missing-glyph boxes throughout the app UI
Add right-to-left page order for two-page view (Arabic and Urdu support)
DXGI print context error: Failed to close print control: No such interface supported (0x80040003)
Windows printing substitutes glyphs in embedded Arial fonts (Brother and Adobe PDF)
Fill & Sign: manage and reuse multiple saved signatures
OCR: accented Latin letters (German ä ö ü ß, French é è ç …) come out as „?“
Windows: printing crashes in d2d1.dll (single-threaded Direct2D factory used by Windows.Data.Pdf worker threads)

detail.readme_excerpt:
PdfCraft

The PDF workbench; an open-source, modern PDF reader and editor, built in pure Rust.
Read, organize, combine, split and secure PDFs in a fast, native app, written in Rust from the ground up.
macOS · Windows · Linux · FreeBSD · the web


PdfCraft on getartcraft.com · ArtCraft · All Crafting Apps



The PdfCraft Showcase, a 13-page specimen PDF, open with the All tools panel and threaded comments.
